YOU COACH. THEY PLAY.

Free Pokémon football.
Your browser is the stadium.

Poké Bowl is a Pokémon football simulator for desktop and mobile browsers. Draft a team from all 151 Kanto Pokémon, name your club, and call offensive plays and defensive counters. Your players run, pass, block and tackle automatically.

Face the computer, turn on Auto for a full broadcast, or invite a friend to a private 1v1 duel. Each Pokémon brings one signature ultimate per set of downs. Scoring earns an end-zone dance and a stadium Dance Cam moment.

No download needed. Guest play is free; guest results are not recorded.

01 / Learn the playbook →Rules, offensive calls, defensive counters, signature ultimates and friend duels.02 / Find your gym club →Scout eight Kanto teams, their starters, actual ratings and CPU play styles.03 / Scout all 151 →Compare Pokémon football ratings at 16 positions. The box score
